q-132702.name: Question 1
q-132702.problem: Find the greatest common divisor of $506$ and $207.$
q-132702.worked_solution:
We use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}506 & = & 207(2) & + & 92 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 207 & = & 92(2) & + & 23 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 92 & = & 23(4) & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $23.$ Therefore, we conclude that the greatest common divisor of $506$ and $207$ is $23.$ Symbolically, we write

$$
\text{gcd}(506,207)=23.
$$

q-98404.name: Question 11
q-98404.problem:
Which of the following statements are true?

I. $\text{gcd}(888,205)=7$

II. $\text{gcd}(888,205)=1$

III. $888$ and $205$ are coprime
q-98404.worked_solution:
Recall that two integers are coprime if their greatest common divisor is $1.$ 

With that in mind, let's examine our statements in turn.

- Statement I is false, while statement II is true. Indeed, let's use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}888 & = & 205\cdot 4 & + & 68 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 205 & = & 68\cdot 3 & + & 1 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 68 & = & 1\cdot 68 & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $1.$ So, the greatest common divisor of $888$ and $205$ is $1:$

$$
\text{gcd}(888,205)=1.
$$

- Statement III is true. Since $\text{gcd}(888,205)=1,$ the numbers are coprime.

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only."

II. $\text{gcd}(2927,1457)=13$

III. $2927$ and $1457$ are not coprime
q-98475.worked_solution:
Recall that two integers are coprime if their greatest common divisor is $1.$ 

With that in mind, let's examine our statements in turn.

- Statement I is true, while statement II is false. Indeed, let's use the Euclidean algorithm, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}2927 & = & 1457\cdot 2 & + & 13 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 1457 & = & 13\cdot 112 & + & 1 \\  & ↙ &  & ↙ &  \\ 13 & = & 1\cdot 13 & + & 0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The last positive remainder is $1.$ So, the greatest common divisor of $2927$ and $1457$ is $1:$

$$
\text{gcd}(2927,1457)=1.
$$

- Statement III is false. Since $\text{gcd}(2927,1457)=1,$ the numbers are coprime.

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only."
